component.name: MemoriesView
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.top.visible = false bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = 1920 bg.height = 1080 bg.color = th.ink m.a = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.b = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.a.id = "memA" m.b.id = "memB" for each p in [m.a, m.b] p.width = 1920 p.height = 1080 p.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" p.opacity = 0 end for
pill = m.top.createChild("Poster") pill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" pill.blendColor = WithAlpha(th.ink, 0.7) pill.translation = [96, 960] pill.width = 420 pill.height = 64 m.caption = m.top.createChild("Label") m.caption.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 24) m.caption.color = th.white m.caption.translation = [96, 960] m.caption.width = 420 m.caption.height = 64 m.caption.horizAlign = "center" m.caption.vertAlign = "center"
m.fade = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.fade.duration = 0.9 m.fade.easeFunction = "inOutCubic" m.fadeIn = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeIn.key = [0, 1] m.fadeIn.keyValue = [0, 1] m.fadeOut = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeOut.key = [0, 1] m.fadeOut.keyValue = [1, 0]
m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.duration = 7 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "advance") m.front = m.b end sub
sub onOpen() m.top.visible = m.top.open if m.top.open m.index = -1 show(1) m.timer.control = "start" else m.timer.control = "stop" end if end sub
sub advance() show(1) end sub
sub show(d as integer) list = m.top.photos n = list.Count() m.index = (m.index + d + n) mod n if m.front.isSameNode(m.a) then back = m.b else back = m.a back.uri = list[m.index] m.fadeIn.fieldToInterp = back.id + ".opacity" m.fadeOut.fieldToInterp = m.front.id + ".opacity" m.fade.control = "start" m.front = back m.caption.text = "Memories · " + (m.index + 1).ToStr() + " of " + n.ToStr() end sub
function handleKey(key as string) as boolean if key = "left" or key = "right" d = 1 if key = "left" then d = -1 show(d) m.timer.control = "stop" m.timer.control = "start" end if return true end function
